# in reference assembly

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inReferenceAssembly`](gmeow-inReferenceAssembly.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inReferenceAssembly>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reference assembly (e.g. GRCh38) in which these sequence coordinates are expressed. Functional: a coordinate tuple is expressed in exactly one assembly; coordinates in another assembly are a different [`SequenceCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md) instance ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SequenceCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single reference assembly sequence coordinates are expressed in; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it and avoid reusing one [`SequenceCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md) across assemblies — coordinates in another assembly are a different instance ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:inReferenceAssembly`](gmeow-inReferenceAssembly.md); liftover to another assembly is a solver computation via [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md).

### Examples

- ex:brca1Coords [`gmeow:inReferenceAssembly`](gmeow-inReferenceAssembly.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameGRCh38`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameGRCh38.md).
